title: R.5 Retire Python bridge and stand-ins; 1,000-node load test
description: Makefile/scripts/docs point at Rust; load test numbers in docs/load-test.md.

title: R.2 tidewater serve: batch conditions sampling over HTTP
description: In ~/tidewater: 'tidewater serve' answering batch queries (points + time -> current, depth, water level, wind) so Rust stand-ins get real conditions.

title: R.3 Stand-in behaviors: copter, VTOL, airship, ground, sailboat, tracker
description: Every platform can run as a stand-in. Authentic ArduPilot MAV_TYPE, mode numbers, mission semantics per docs/AUTHENTICITY.md.

title: R.4 Rust bridge (port with parity, keyed by uid)
description: crates/murmur-bridge: same HTTP/WS API as bridge/murmur_bridge, vehicles keyed by uid (sysid per link). Telemetry plan, LinkStats, task lifecycle. Console switched to uid.

title: Phase R: Rust core (stand-ins, bridge port)
description: See docs/PLAN.md Phase R and DECISIONS.md (Rust for the live path). Exit: make goldengate runs on Rust bridge + stand-ins; 1,000-node stand-in load test documented.

title: R.1 Rust stand-in engine (port with parity)
description: crates/murmur-standins: port sim/standins.py behaviors plane/boat/drifter/sub; same standins.json input; parity tests vs Python; follows docs/AUTHENTICITY.md stand-in contract; uid vs sysid.

title: Phase F: AI agents via MCP (nominate and explain, never authorize)
description: docs/PLAN.md 'Phase F': MCP server exposing world model with staleness and intent tools; no approve tool; read AeroMind and Pharos agent layers first.
acceptance_criteria: Agents never bypass a check in any test run.

title: Phase E: engagement decision chain (abstract effects, human-only authorization)
description: docs/PLAN.md 'Phase E': nominate, fail-closed checks, preview, human authorization bound to the track picture, abort, assess. No autonomous engagement; effects abstract.
acceptance_criteria: Every invariant has a scenario that tries to break it.

title: Phase C2: tracks and sensing
description: docs/PLAN.md 'Phase C2': scenario contacts (truth) vs bridge tracks (perception); sensor range/type in platforms.toml; identity confidence, staleness, misclassification.
acceptance_criteria: Tracks visibly age and degrade in the console.

title: C.4 Append-only audit log and replay
description: docs/PLAN.md C.4: logs/audit/<run>.jsonl with inputs recorded per decision; scripts/replay.py recomputes decisions (not physics) and must match exactly.

title: C.5 Inbox UI: approvals and alerts in one queue
description: docs/PLAN.md C.5: InboxPanel ranked by severity; alerts from existing detection (lost link, NOT MOVING, left task, failed, ack timeout); ack/snooze; click flies to vehicle; top-bar badge.

title: C.2 Fail-closed rules layer
description: docs/PLAN.md C.2: rules.py pure functions (capability, readiness, turn radius, domain water/land via tidewater, geofence/no-go polygons, reserves).

title: C.3 Risk-tier policy file
description: docs/PLAN.md C.3: policy.py + sim/policy.toml, first match wins; add armed=true to platforms.toml (switchblade, fpv, ugv_armed); agent intents never auto-approved above auto tier.

title: C.1 Intent model and API
description: docs/PLAN.md C.1: Intent schema and state machine in bridge/murmur_bridge/intents.py; POST /api/intents, approve/reject, GET /api/inbox; /api/tasks becomes a thin wrapper; approved intents dispatch via TaskManager; pending approvals expire.

title: Phase G: evaluation harness, metrics and published results
description: docs/PLAN.md 'Phase G': seeded adversarial scenarios, batch runs, agent vs rules vs human-only, rubber-stamping metrics (SandTable definitions).
acceptance_criteria: Results published, including what went wrong.

title: Phase D: degraded links (link emulator, fallbacks, dead reckoning)
description: docs/PLAN.md 'Phase D'.

title: Phase C: intents, rules, risk tiers, audit log, inbox
description: See docs/PLAN.md 'Phase C'. Every action becomes an intent with a recorded decision trail; consequential ones wait for a human in one inbox.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/replay.py recomputes every check and policy decision from a run's audit log and matches exactly.

title: 100-node load test
description: Fleet of 100 (mostly stand-ins): measure bridge CPU, WebSocket throughput, browser frame time; record in docs.

title: Phase B: full-spectrum roster and wider area
description: HALE/MALE/CCA, tactical VTOL, small UAS, loitering munition, quad, FPV, aerostat/LTA; UGVs (logistics, armed, mine-laying, recon); USVs (small fast, medium, large, sail, drifting buoy); subs (ROV small, AUV medium, XLUUV large). Area: SF Bay + approaches (~100 km). Proper symbols.
close_reason: Done in Phase A: 22-type catalog, stand-ins, full-spectrum fleet; area widening deferred (docs/PLAN.md)

title: Telemetry rate plan + change-only UI protocol
description: Bridge requests only needed messages at per-domain rates; WS sends initial state then deltas (changed vehicles, appended trail points, taskings on change).

title: Stand-in vehicle simulator (MAVLink-speaking kinematic models)
description: One asyncio process simulating many vehicles, each on its own UDP link. Implements heartbeat/telemetry, COMMAND_LONG acks (arm, mode, set mission current), mission upload, AUTO/RTL/hold/loiter semantics, DO_JUMP, takeoff, loiter circles; ArduPilot mode numbering per MAV_TYPE so the bridge needs no special cases. Platform kinematics from the catalog. Labelled stand-in in the UI.
close_reason: sim/standins.py: MAVLink kinematic stand-ins with modes/missions/acks, tidewater currents/drift/seabed; tested with HALE/MALE/CCA/MUSV/buoy/AUV/XLUUV

title: Platform catalog, fleet files, and readable vehicle identity
description: sim/platforms.toml: per-platform specs (approx public figures), sim backend (sitl|standin), link class, symbol, callsign prefix. sim/fleets/*.toml: composition + spawn. Launcher writes sim/run/fleet.json (sysid -> platform, callsign); bridge serves it; UI shows callsign + model/role in fleet rows and map labels (user requirement).
close_reason: platforms.toml (22 types), fleet files, fleet.json manifest, callsign+model+role in UI

title: Phase A: scale plumbing to 100 nodes
description: Per-message telemetry rates (SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL, not REQUEST_DATA_STREAM ALL), change-only bridge->UI updates with incremental trails, stand-in vehicles, 100-node load test (bridge CPU, WS bytes/s, UI frame time).
close_reason: Phase A complete: catalog, stand-ins, telemetry plan, deltas, 100-node test (docs/load-test.md). ArduPlane extra streams tracked separately.

title: Write-up: console behavior at 30% packet loss
description: Run the netem profiles, record link stats, command latency (sent->acked->done), retries, and track error vs truth. Publish findings and design trade-offs.

title: Dead reckoning + uncertainty cone for lost tracks
description: When a vehicle goes silent, project position from last velocity/heading and draw a growing uncertainty region (deck.gl or maplibre polygon). Grow with time-since-last-message and vehicle kind (plane faster than boat).

title: Safe command queue under intermittent links
description: Hold operator intent until confirmed; retry without double-execution (mission upload is transactional, COMMAND_LONG uses confirmation field). Survive bridge restart and vehicle reboot (detect by heartbeat/boot time, re-evaluate ops). Show intended vs confirmed state on map.

title: netem harness: degrade per-vehicle links
description: Run SITL vehicles in network namespaces or containers so tc netem shapes only the vehicle<->bridge UDP link (not lo, which would also degrade the browser WebSocket). Scripted profiles: clean, 10%, 30% loss, +300ms latency, 64 kbps. Needs sudo for tc.
close_reason: Superseded by the user-space link emulator in Phase D (docs/DECISIONS.md)

title: Authenticity fields: real-world protocol per platform in catalog and Platforms panel
description: Add protocol/link-standard fields from docs/AUTHENTICITY.md to sim/platforms.toml, /api/platforms, PlatformsPanel.

title: 2D/3D map toggle
description: Tilted 3D view with terrain + bathymetry, vehicles at true altitude/depth with stems and 3D trails, translucent sea surface; toggle persists.
close_reason: Done: deck.gl layers on MapLibre v5 terrain

title: SITL antenna tracker stalls ~45 deg short of targets east of it
description: Track task: tracker's own computed bearing is correct (NAV_CONTROLLER_OUTPUT nav_bearing=101 for a boat at true bearing 101.7) but ATTITUDE yaw creeps to ~45 deg and stalls (error ~56 deg). Same stall with YAW_RANGE 340 (sim mount is +/-170 per libraries/SITL/SIM_Tracker.h; did not verify the param took effect). Locking on works for targets in other directions (locked on AIR 01 at startup). Suspects: SERVO1 PWM range vs SIM_Tracker yaw_input scaling, or position-servo PID in AntennaTracker/servos.cpp update_yaw_position_servo. Check SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW and PARAM YAW_RANGE.

title: Publish vehicles as Cursor-on-Target to a TAK server
description: pytak -> FreeTAKServer or OpenTAKServer in Docker (CoT over TCP 8087). Map plane/boat to CoT types (a-f-A-M-F-Q / a-f-S). Verify in ATAK or WinTAK.

title: C.6 Bridge tests (rules, policy, replay, LinkStats)
description: Unit tests for LinkStats (gaps, reorder, wrap) and a fake-vehicle harness for mission upload retry, ACK rejection, and supersede.

title: Telemetry prioritization under low bandwidth
description: Replace REQUEST_DATA_STREAM ALL with SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL tiers (position/heartbeat first, attitude/IMU last), adapt rates to measured loss. Send deltas instead of full snapshots on the WebSocket.

title: ArduPlane SITL still streams AHRS/SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW etc. with MAV1_* rates at 0
description: After sim/params/common.parm zeroes MAV1_* (verified 0 on the vehicle), plane/quadplane SITL still sends ~31 msg/s on SERIAL0 (AHRS, AHRS2, SERVO_OUTPUT_RAW, SYSTEM_TIME at ~1 Hz each) vs ~9 for copter/rover/sub. Find which ArduPlane path schedules them (default intervals? SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL bucket side effect?). Low impact at current scale.

title: Map label declutter
description: milsymbol labels overlap when vehicles are bunched (planes on the runway). Hide or offset labels at low zoom, or show callsign on hover.
